label: Unified Care Model
comment: Complete UCM model including Core, Participation, and Domain semantic layers.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ActivityFocus.label: Activity Focus
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ActivityFocus.comment: The matter, condition, or situation toward which a coordinated activity is orchestrated and which the activity seeks to jointly maintain, update, resolve, or bring about.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCommitment.label: Care Commitment
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCommitment.comment: A continuing agreement among participants to coordinate care toward a joint purpose, according to terms or conditions that may evolve.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageGa.label: Care Coverage Gap
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageGa.comment: A condition in which a care coverage requirement is in force but is not satisfied by any applicable in-force care commitment during a specified interval.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageRe.label: Care Coverage Requirement
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareCoverageRe.comment: A requirement that some participation in care coordination concerns an activity focus, in a given role, over a defined context or interval.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareTrajectory.label: Care Trajectory Context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CareTrajectory.comment: A position or extent defined relative to the progression of a care process, state trajectory, or coordinated activity, which does not require anchoring to clock or calendar time.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinationRe.label: Care Coordination Request
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinationRe.comment: A process in which coordination is requested between participating entities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinativeAc.label: Coordinative Care Activity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CoordinativeAc.comment: A situated activity whose process is shared by participating entities in its care coordination lifecycle.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#DefinitionArti.label: Definition Artifact
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#DefinitionArti.comment: A ruleset, policy definition, constraint, or governance artifact.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Entity.label: Entity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Entity.comment: A stable independently identifiable semantic thing.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Handshake.label: Handshake
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Handshake.comment: A coordinative process through which participating entities negotiate mutual participation in a shared activity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationArt.label: Information Artifact
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#InformationArt.comment: A logical information abstraction or computable information object.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MatchClaim.label: Match Claim
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MatchClaim.comment: An assertion that two or more entity references co-refer to the same identifiable entity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Membership.label: Membership
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Membership.comment: Contextual membership relationship between an Entity and a SocialGroupEntity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MembershipCrit.label: Membership Criteria
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#MembershipCrit.comment: Rules or conditions defining membership within a SocialGroupEntity.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Organization.label: Organization
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Organization.comment: Operational or governance-oriented social entity maintaining continuity independent of membership changes.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Participation.label: Participation
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Participation.comment: Contextual involvement of an Entity within a Process and Semantic Context.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Person.label: Person
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Person.comment: A homo sapiens (NCBI) with the social context of a Person.  Looking for an object property of cco:PersonRole to have a "similar to" skos: relationship.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Process.label: Process
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Process.comment: A bounded interaction or activity occurring over time.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Role.label: Role
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Role.comment: A contextual, anti-rigid classification assumed through participation.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SemanticContex.label: Semantic Context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SemanticContex.comment: An interpretive environment, governance scope, or applicability boundary.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SocialGroupEnt.label: Social Group Entity
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#SocialGroupEnt.comment: A collective grouping of participating entities.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Statement.label: Statement
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#Statement.comment: An informational assertion, finding, determination, or conclusion.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#acceptsRequest.label: accepts request
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#acceptsRequest.comment: A participating entity accepts a care coordination request.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#enactiveDuring.label: enactive during
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#enactiveDuring.comment: Relates a participation to the temporal extent during which that participation is enactive.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasActivityFoc.label: has activity focus
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasActivityFoc.comment: Situates a process within an activity focus.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCareTraject.label: has care trajectory context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCareTraject.comment: Relates a UCM semantic subject to a temporal position or extent defined relative to the internal progression of a process, state trajectory, or coordinated activity rather than directly relative to an external clock or calendar.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClient.label: has client
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClient.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClosureReas.label: has closure reason
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasClosureReas.comment: Relates a closed care coordination request to the reason it was closed.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCommitmentS.label: has commitment status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasCommitmentS.comment: Relates a care commitment to whether it is binding on its participants.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandoffStat.label: has handoff status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandoffStat.comment: Relates a handshake to where responsibility for its agreed services stands between the sending and receiving parties.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandshakeFu.label: has handshake fulfillment
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasHandshakeFu.comment: Relates a handshake to how much of its negotiated service has been delivered.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasLifecycleSt.label: has lifecycle state
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasLifecycleSt.comment: Relates a process to a lifecycle state.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasPatient.label: has patient
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasPatient.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasReferralDis.label: has referral disposition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasReferralDis.comment: Relates a care coordination request to the receiving party's decision on it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasResident.label: has resident
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasResident.comment: Convenience projection derived from participation semantics.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasTemporalCon.label: has temporal context
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#hasTemporalCon.comment: Relates a UCM semantic subject to a temporal entity that qualifies when that subject occurs, obtains, applies, participates, or is otherwise temporally situated.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#negotiates.label: negotiates
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#negotiates.comment: Relates a handshake to the care coordination process whose participation relationship it negotiates.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#occursDuring.label: occurs during
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#occursDuring.comment: Relates a process to the temporal extent during which the process occurs.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#statementSubje.label: statement subject
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#statementSubje.comment: Relates a statement to the contextual participation it is about.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#validDuring.label: valid during
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#validDuring.comment: Relates a semantic subject or statement to the temporal extent during which its described condition, state, relationship, participation, or other semantics apply.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ClosureReason.label: Closure Reason
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ClosureReason.description: Why did the care coordination episode end?

concepts.label: Declined by the person
concepts.definition: The person chose not to receive the requested services.

concepts.label: Person unreachable
concepts.definition: The receiving party could not reach the person.

concepts.label: Connected
concepts.definition: The person was connected to the requested services.

concepts.label: No longer needed
concepts.definition: The need was resolved, or stopped applying, without the requested services.

concepts.label: Not connected
concepts.definition: The episode ended without connecting the person to the requested services. Record a narrower concept when the reason is known.

concepts.label: Ineligible
concepts.definition: The person does not meet the receiving program's eligibility criteria.

concepts.label: Missing verification
concepts.definition: Documentation or verification the receiving party requires was not provided.

concepts.label: Other reason
concepts.definition: Not connected for a reason not listed here.

concepts.label: Out of area
concepts.definition: The person is outside the receiving party's service area.

concepts.label: Program at capacity
concepts.definition: The receiving program had no capacity for the person.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CommitmentStat.label: Commitment Status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#CommitmentStat.description: Is a care commitment binding on its participants?

concepts.label: In force
concepts.definition: The commitment is agreed and binding on its participants.

concepts.label: Lapsed
concepts.definition: The commitment ended without being released, for example by expiry or abandonment.

concepts.label: Proposed
concepts.definition: The commitment has been offered but not yet agreed.

concepts.label: Released
concepts.definition: The commitment ended deliberately: completed, handed over or ended by agreement.

concepts.label: Suspended
concepts.definition: The commitment is agreed but temporarily not binding.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandoffStatus.label: Handoff Status
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandoffStatus.description: Where does responsibility for the agreed services stand between the sending and receiving parties?

concepts.label: Acknowledged
concepts.definition: The receiving party has acknowledged the handoff but has not yet assumed responsibility.

concepts.label: Assumed
concepts.definition: The receiving party has assumed responsibility for the agreed services, and the sending party has released it.

concepts.label: Dropped
concepts.definition: The sending party released responsibility before the receiving party assumed it, leaving no one responsible for the agreed services.

concepts.label: Offered
concepts.definition: The sending party has offered responsibility for the agreed services; the receiving party has not acknowledged it.

concepts.label: Returned
concepts.definition: The receiving party handed responsibility back to the sending party.

concepts.label: Shared
concepts.definition: The sending and receiving parties hold responsibility for the agreed services jointly.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandshakeFulfi.label: Handshake Fulfillment
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#HandshakeFulfi.description: How much of the service negotiated in a handshake has been delivered?

concepts.label: Confirmed delivered
concepts.definition: The requesting party has confirmed that the negotiated services were delivered.

concepts.label: Not started
concepts.definition: None of the negotiated services has been delivered yet.

concepts.label: Partially delivered
concepts.definition: Some, but not all, of the negotiated services have been delivered.

concepts.label: Reported delivered
concepts.definition: The delivering party reports the negotiated services delivered; the requesting party has not confirmed it.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#LifecycleState.label: Lifecycle State
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#LifecycleState.description: A state associated with a process during a portion of its lifecycle.

concepts.label: Accepted Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: A care coordination request that has been accepted for ongoing care.

concepts.label: Declined Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: This care request was denied.

concepts.label: Pending Care Coordination Lifecycle
concepts.definition: A pending care coordination request.

https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ReferralDispos.label: Referral Disposition
https://www.w3.org/ns/ucm#ReferralDispos.description: What has the receiving party decided about a care coordination request?

concepts.label: Accepted
concepts.definition: The receiving party agreed to take part in the requested coordination.

concepts.label: Declined
concepts.definition: The receiving party declined the request. The reason is recorded with a ucm:ClosureReason concept.

concepts.label: Expired
concepts.definition: The receiving party made no decision within the time allowed for a response.

concepts.label: Pending
concepts.definition: The request has been sent and the receiving party has not yet decided.

concepts.label: Withdrawn
concepts.definition: The requesting party withdrew the request before the receiving party decided.

properties.message: acceptsRequest target is not typed as ucm:Participation.
Activity focus is not typed as ucm:ActivityFocus.
Affiliation target is not typed as ucm:Organization.
Care trajectory context is not typed as ucm:CareTrajectoryContext.

sparql.message: Closure reason recorded on a request that is still pending a decision.
Closure reason is neither in ucm:ClosureReason nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A coordination request holds at most one closure reason, identified by IRI.

sparql.message: Commitment status is neither in ucm:CommitmentStatus nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A care commitment holds at most one commitment status, identified by IRI.
definedByArtifact target is not typed as ucm:DefinitionArtifact.

sparql.message: Coordination process declares no activity focus, directly or through a process it negotiates.
Participation uses both validFrom/validTo and enactiveDuring. The two encodings can diverge; prefer enactiveDuring.
Handshake reports services delivered for a request that was declined, withdrawn or expired.
Handoff status is neither in ucm:HandoffStatus nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A handshake holds at most one handoff status, identified by IRI.

sparql.message: Handshake negotiates itself, directly or through a chain: the negotiation has no base case.
Handshake fulfillment is neither in ucm:HandshakeFulfillment nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A handshake holds at most one fulfillment state, identified by IRI.
A handshake negotiates participation in at least one process.

sparql.message: Lifecycle state is neither in ucm:LifecycleState nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A process holds at most one lifecycle state, identified by IRI. (Relax to temporalized state assertions once those exist.)
A membership belongs to exactly one member entity (via hasMembership).
A membership is in exactly one social group.
Membership target is not typed as ucm:SocialGroupEntity.

sparql.message: An entity participates through this participation via participatesThrough, but the participation names a different participating entity.
A process lists this participation via hasParticipant, but the participation occurs within a different process.

properties.message: Assumed role is not typed as ucm:Role.
A participation occurs within exactly one process.
The process a participation occurs within is not typed as ucm:Process.
A participation has exactly one participating entity, which must be a node, not a literal.
Participating entity is not typed as ucm:Entity or a subclass. Assert a UCM type, or validate with OWL RL inference if it is typed in a mapped ontology.
Participation context is not typed as ucm:SemanticContext.
validFrom is single-valued and must be xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp.
validTo is single-valued and must be xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp.

sparql.message: Convenience projection (hasClient/hasPatient/hasResident) has no backing participation with the matching role.
Referral disposition is neither in ucm:ReferralDisposition nor SKOS-mapped to a concept that is.

properties.message: A coordination request holds at most one referral disposition, identified by IRI.
Generating process is not typed as ucm:Process.
Statement declares no semantic context; its interpretation depends on one.
A statement is made once: statementDate is single-valued and must be xsd:dateTime or xsd:dateTimeStamp.
Statement subject is not typed as ucm:Participation.

shapes.message: Temporal context must be an OWL-Time entity, not a literal. Wrap a bare timestamp in a time:Instant.
